title: Concept: Lock file without a plugin API version
description: composer.lock declares a composer.lock that records no plugin API version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a composer.lock that records no plugin API version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.lock (composer).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a composer.lock that records no plugin API version.
